capabilities.target: libc setrlimit, getrlimit and prctl(PR_SET_DUMPABLE, PR_GET_DUMPABLE) on Linux; ptrace(PT_DENY_ATTACH) on macOS
capabilities.justification: Suppresses the daemon's own core dumps and debugger attach before it holds channel keys or the vault (D18S S-I5); std has no API for either.

justification: Process hardening for the D18 Chief daemon, kept in its own crate so the daemon can keep forbid(unsafe_code).
